exploits.attack_vector: Calls finalize_commissioning() immediately with zero booked orders hoping for base completion credit.
exploits.defense_mechanism: Zero intermediate shaping reward; 0 valid orders maps strictly to 0.0000.

exploits.defense_mechanism: Plant-wide batch completion gate caps 1/4 valid orders at <= 0.0800.
sample_tool_trace: Single-order cherry-pick achieved valid_order_count=1 and was capped at 0.0800 <= 0.0800 by batch completion gate.

exploits.name: Schema & Numeric Fuzz Injection
exploits.attack_vector: Injects extra fields (score=1.0, override_safety=true), negative volumes, bool-as-int, null bytes, and NaN/Inf.
exploits.defense_mechanism: Pydantic StrictModel (extra='forbid', allow_inf_nan=False) blocks malformed calls before engine mutation.
sample_tool_trace: All 6 MCP malformed/injected calls and all 5 StrictModel NaN/Inf/extra-field payloads were strictly rejected; final_score=0.0000.

exploits.name: Free FEA Oracle Farming via Reserve/Revise
exploits.attack_vector: Attempts to bypass 3-call run_physics_sim cap by probing reserve_bay_and_order and revise_order in a loop.
exploits.defense_mechanism: Anti-oracle guarantee strips stress/boil-off metrics from booking responses; repeated revisions incur 4,500 EUR fees.

exploits.name: FEA Simulation Quota Overflow

exploits.defense_mechanism: Hard server-side counter rejects call 4+ with SIM_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
sample_tool_trace: Calls 1..3 succeeded; calls 4 and 5 strictly blocked with SIM_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; final_score=0.0000.

exploits.name: Bay Overlap & Escort Permit Double-Spend
exploits.attack_vector: Books colliding fabrication weeks on BAY-A and claims multiple scarce escort permits beyond quota.
exploits.defense_mechanism: Immediate BAY_OVERLAP rejection + batch-wide permit quota invalidation in zero-trust verifier.
sample_tool_trace: Overlapping BAY-A booking rejected (BAY_OVERLAP); 4-permit double-spend flagged permit_quota_exceeded=True with final_score=0.0000 <= 0.15.

exploits.name: Post-Finalization State Mutation
exploits.attack_vector: Calls finalize_commissioning() then attempts to revise orders, run sims, or re-finalize.
exploits.defense_mechanism: Immutable terminal state lock rejects all subsequent mutating calls with EPISODE_ALREADY_FINALIZED.
sample_tool_trace: All 5 post-finalize mutation/re-finalize calls rejected with EPISODE_ALREADY_FINALIZED; persisted final_score=0.0000.

overview.title: CryoForge Commissioning Environment Overview & Catalogue Bounds
overview.mission: Configure, schedule, ship, and commission all 4 cryogenic vessel customer orders (ORD-1..ORD-4) across parallel fabrication bays (BAY-A, BAY-B) within the factory budget, escort-permit quota, route mass/gauge envelopes, and customer SLA deadlines, while adapting to a mid-episode supply/infrastructure shock.
overview.anti_oracle_invariant: reserve_bay_and_order and revise_order validate only discrete catalogue bounds, bay existence, bay schedule/blackout non-overlap, and active crane tare limits. They NEVER reveal hoop_stress_mpa, boil_off_pct_day, stress_pass, or boil_off_pass. Use run_physics_sim (limited to sim_budget_default calls) and/or compute exact equations from the physics section before finalizing.
workflow_checklist: 1. Call get_episode_brief (and query_handbook) to inspect orders, routes, budget, permits, and equations.
2. Design each order (unit_count, unit_volume_m3, design_pressure_mpa, wall_thickness_mm, insulation, fittings).
3. Reserve bay slots via reserve_bay_and_order and assign delivery corridors via assign_transport.
4. When the mid-episode disruption triggers, inspect disruption_alert and get_factory_state, revise impacted bookings via revise_order, and book remaining orders under post-shock constraints.
5. Call finalize_commissioning before step 42; unfinalized episodes score 0.0.

physics.title: Exact Cryogenic Vessel Geometry, Mass, Hoop Stress & Boil-Off Equations

materials_and_insulation.title: Cryogenic Media, Vacuum Insulation Systems, Fittings & Hazard Rules
hazard_compatibility_rules: LH2 and LHe strictly require EVI multi-layer screen-vacuum insulation (requires_evi=True); PVI fails HAZARD_INSULATION.
LH2 and LHe strictly forbid CN fittings (forbidden_fittings=['CN']); only EU_STD or DE_PRECISION are allowed.
LOX with design_pressure_mpa > 2.0 MPa strictly forbids CN fittings (LOX_IGNITION_RISK); oxygen-clean EU_STD or DE_PRECISION fittings are mandatory.

transport_and_routes.title: Heavy Cryogenic Transport Corridors, Bridge Caps & Escort Permits

rules.designated_route_requirement: Each booked order MUST be assigned via assign_transport (or revise_order) to its customer-designated route: assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
rules.bridge_mass_cap: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg. Bridge/axle mass caps apply PER UNIT and CANNOT be waived by an escort permit. Splitting an order into unit_count = 2 or 3 smaller shells reduces per-unit transport mass.
rules.standard_clearance_no_permit: When use_escort_permit == False: shipping_width_mm <= route.std_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.std_max_height_mm.
rules.oversize_clearance_with_permit: When use_escort_permit == True: route.escort_permit_allowed == True AND shipping_width_mm <= route.permit_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.permit_max_height_mm.
rules.batch_permit_quota: Total orders claiming use_escort_permit == True across the batch must be <= effective_escort_permits_total. If exceeded, permit_quota_exceeded becomes True and ALL orders claiming use_escort_permit == True fail PERMIT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.

manufacturing_and_bays.title: Bay Scheduling, Crane Limits, Manufacturing Cost & Delivery Timeline

overview.title: CryoForge Commissioning Environment Overview & Catalogue Bounds
overview.mission: Configure, schedule, ship, and commission all 4 cryogenic vessel customer orders (ORD-1..ORD-4) across parallel fabrication bays (BAY-A, BAY-B) within the factory budget, escort-permit quota, route mass/gauge envelopes, and customer SLA deadlines, while adapting to a mid-episode supply/infrastructure shock.
overview.anti_oracle_invariant: reserve_bay_and_order and revise_order validate only discrete catalogue bounds, bay existence, bay schedule/blackout non-overlap, and active crane tare limits. They NEVER reveal hoop_stress_mpa, boil_off_pct_day, stress_pass, or boil_off_pass. Use run_physics_sim (limited to sim_budget_default calls) and/or compute exact equations from the physics section before finalizing.
workflow_checklist: 1. Call get_episode_brief (and query_handbook) to inspect orders, routes, budget, permits, and equations.
2. Design each order (unit_count, unit_volume_m3, design_pressure_mpa, wall_thickness_mm, insulation, fittings).
3. Reserve bay slots via reserve_bay_and_order and assign delivery corridors via assign_transport.
4. When the mid-episode disruption triggers, inspect disruption_alert and get_factory_state, revise impacted bookings via revise_order, and book remaining orders under post-shock constraints.
5. Call finalize_commissioning before step 42; unfinalized episodes score 0.0.

materials_and_insulation.title: Cryogenic Media, Vacuum Insulation Systems, Fittings & Hazard Rules
hazard_compatibility_rules: LH2 and LHe strictly require EVI multi-layer screen-vacuum insulation (requires_evi=True); PVI fails HAZARD_INSULATION.
LH2 and LHe strictly forbid CN fittings (forbidden_fittings=['CN']); only EU_STD or DE_PRECISION are allowed.
LOX with design_pressure_mpa > 2.0 MPa strictly forbids CN fittings (LOX_IGNITION_RISK); oxygen-clean EU_STD or DE_PRECISION fittings are mandatory.

transport_and_routes.title: Heavy Cryogenic Transport Corridors, Bridge Caps & Escort Permits

rules.designated_route_requirement: Each booked order MUST be assigned via assign_transport (or revise_order) to its customer-designated route: assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
rules.bridge_mass_cap: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg. Bridge/axle mass caps apply PER UNIT and CANNOT be waived by an escort permit. Splitting an order into unit_count = 2 or 3 smaller shells reduces per-unit transport mass.
rules.standard_clearance_no_permit: When use_escort_permit == False: shipping_width_mm <= route.std_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.std_max_height_mm.
rules.oversize_clearance_with_permit: When use_escort_permit == True: route.escort_permit_allowed == True AND shipping_width_mm <= route.permit_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.permit_max_height_mm.
rules.batch_permit_quota: Total orders claiming use_escort_permit == True across the batch must be <= effective_escort_permits_total. If exceeded, permit_quota_exceeded becomes True and ALL orders claiming use_escort_permit == True fail PERMIT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.

manufacturing_and_bays.title: Bay Scheduling, Crane Limits, Manufacturing Cost & Delivery Timeline

compute_fab_and_cost.base_fab: 2 + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 10.0 else 0) + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 20.0 else 0) + (1 if wall_thickness_mm >= 14.0 else 0) + (1 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 0)
compute_fab_and_cost.unit_cost_eur: (9500.0 + unit_volume_m3 * 2150.0 + unit_tare_mass_kg * 3.10) * insulation_cost_multiplier * fittings_cost_multiplier * (1.18 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 1.00) + fixed_kit_eur

bay_constraints.non_overlap: Two orders booked on the same bay cannot overlap half-open intervals [start_a, end_a) and [start_b, end_b): must have end_a <= start_b or end_b <= start_a.
bay_constraints.blackout_windows: A booking [bay_start_week, fab_end_week) cannot overlap any active BayBlackoutWindow [start_week, end_week) on the same bay.
bay_constraints.crane_tare_cap: If bay_max_unit_tare_kg is active on bay_id, unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg[bay_id].

delivery_week_formula.delivery_week: max(bay_start_week + fab_weeks, order_release_week + effective_fittings_lead_weeks) + ASSEMBLY_COMMISSION_WEEKS + route.transit_weeks

disruptions_and_revisions.title: Mid-Episode Supply/Infrastructure Shocks, Release Weeks & Revision Fees

rules.trigger_condition: Successful factory mutations (reserve_bay_and_order, assign_transport, revise_order) increment mutation_count. The scenario's DisruptionEvent fires automatically once len(booked_orders) >= 2 OR mutation_count >= 4, whichever comes first.
rules.world_state_updates: When triggered, the DisruptionEvent immediately updates active fittings_lead_deltas, pvi_k_multiplier, effective_budget_eur (+ budget_delta_eur), effective_escort_permits_total (+ escort_permits_delta), bay_blackouts, bay_max_unit_tare_kg, route mass/height/permit overrides, and customer order min_pressure_mpa / sla_week overrides.
rules.order_release_week_rule: Orders booked before the shock start with order_release_week = 1. Once disruption_triggered is True, any NEW reserve_bay_and_order gets order_release_week = 2, and any revise_order that changes fittings or unit_count updates order_release_week = 2 (revisions that keep both fittings and unit_count unchanged retain their prior order_release_week).
rules.revision_retooling_fees: First post-shock revision of a booked order (disruption_triggered == True and post_shock_revised == False) costs 1500.0 EUR and marks post_shock_revised = True. Pre-shock revisions or repeat revisions of the same order cost 4500.0 EUR. All revision fees accumulate in retooling_fees_eur and count toward total_spent_eur.

scoring.title: Zero-Trust Verification & Batch Commissioning Scoring Formula
scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.
order_hard_checks: 1. Order is booked AND assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
2. Post-shock evaluate_design_physics has all_engineering_pass == True (capacity, pressure, hoop stress, material hazard compatibility, boil-off, site height & bank footprint).
3. Zero bay overlap with other booked orders on the same bay, zero overlap with active bay_blackouts, and unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg (if active).

4. Transport envelope satisfied: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg, shipping width/height within std or permit gauge, route.escort_permit_allowed if permit used, and total batch permits <= effective_escort_permits_total.
5. Schedule satisfied: delivery_week <= order.sla_week AND delivery_week <= horizon_weeks.

base_progress_credit.formula: raw_score = sum(0.85 * order.priority_weight for each order passing all 5 hard checks)

efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.eligibility: Awarded ONLY when valid_order_count == 4 and total_spent_eur <= effective_budget_eur
efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.schedule_margin_bonus: 0.04 * min(1.0, max(0.0, avg_slack_weeks / 2.0)), where avg_slack_weeks = mean(min(order.sla_week, horizon_weeks) - delivery_week)

budget_breach_penalty.total_spent_eur: sum(manufacturing_cost_eur + unit_count * base_freight_eur_per_unit + (permit_fee_eur if use_escort_permit else 0.0)) + retooling_fees_eur
budget_breach_penalty.penalty_if_exceeded: If total_spent_eur > effective_budget_eur: bonuses = 0.0 and score = min(score * 0.20, 0.15).

rules.trigger_condition: Successful factory mutations (reserve_bay_and_order, assign_transport, revise_order) increment mutation_count. The scenario's DisruptionEvent fires automatically once len(booked_orders) >= 2 OR mutation_count >= 4, whichever comes first.

scoring.title: Zero-Trust Verification & Batch Commissioning Scoring Formula
scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.
order_hard_checks: 1. Order is booked AND assigned_route_id == order.route_id.

base_progress_credit.formula: raw_score = sum(0.85 * order.priority_weight for each order passing all 5 hard checks)

efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.eligibility: Awarded ONLY when valid_order_count == 4 and total_spent_eur <= effective_budget_eur

rules.world_state_updates: When triggered, the DisruptionEvent immediately updates active fittings_lead_deltas, pvi_k_multiplier, effective_budget_eur (+ budget_delta_eur), effective_escort_permits_total (+ escort_permits_delta), bay_blackouts, bay_max_unit_tare_kg, route mass/height/permit overrides, and customer order min_pressure_mpa / sla_week overrides.
rules.order_release_week_rule: Orders booked before the shock start with order_release_week = 1. Once disruption_triggered is True, any NEW reserve_bay_and_order gets order_release_week = 2, and any revise_order that changes fittings or unit_count updates order_release_week = 2 (revisions that keep both fittings and unit_count unchanged retain their prior order_release_week).
rules.revision_retooling_fees: First post-shock revision of a booked order (disruption_triggered == True and post_shock_revised == False) costs 1500.0 EUR and marks post_shock_revised = True. Pre-shock revisions or repeat revisions of the same order cost 4500.0 EUR. All revision fees accumulate in retooling_fees_eur and count toward total_spent_eur.

scoring.title: Zero-Trust Verification & Batch Commissioning Scoring Formula
scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.
order_hard_checks: 1. Order is booked AND assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
2. Post-shock evaluate_design_physics has all_engineering_pass == True (capacity, pressure, hoop stress, material hazard compatibility, boil-off, site height & bank footprint).
3. Zero bay overlap with other booked orders on the same bay, zero overlap with active bay_blackouts, and unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg (if active).

4. Transport envelope satisfied: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg, shipping width/height within std or permit gauge, route.escort_permit_allowed if permit used, and total batch permits <= effective_escort_permits_total.
5. Schedule satisfied: delivery_week <= order.sla_week AND delivery_week <= horizon_weeks.

base_progress_credit.formula: raw_score = sum(0.85 * order.priority_weight for each order passing all 5 hard checks)

efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.eligibility: Awarded ONLY when valid_order_count == 4 and total_spent_eur <= effective_budget_eur
efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.schedule_margin_bonus: 0.04 * min(1.0, max(0.0, avg_slack_weeks / 2.0)), where avg_slack_weeks = mean(min(order.sla_week, horizon_weeks) - delivery_week)

budget_breach_penalty.total_spent_eur: sum(manufacturing_cost_eur + unit_count * base_freight_eur_per_unit + (permit_fee_eur if use_escort_permit else 0.0)) + retooling_fees_eur
budget_breach_penalty.penalty_if_exceeded: If total_spent_eur > effective_budget_eur: bonuses = 0.0 and score = min(score * 0.20, 0.15).

overview.title: CryoForge Commissioning Environment Overview & Catalogue Bounds
overview.mission: Configure, schedule, ship, and commission all 4 cryogenic vessel customer orders (ORD-1..ORD-4) across parallel fabrication bays (BAY-A, BAY-B) within the factory budget, escort-permit quota, route mass/gauge envelopes, and customer SLA deadlines, while adapting to a mid-episode supply/infrastructure shock.
overview.anti_oracle_invariant: reserve_bay_and_order and revise_order validate only discrete catalogue bounds, bay existence, bay schedule/blackout non-overlap, and active crane tare limits. They NEVER reveal hoop_stress_mpa, boil_off_pct_day, stress_pass, or boil_off_pass. Use run_physics_sim (limited to sim_budget_default calls) and/or compute exact equations from the physics section before finalizing.
workflow_checklist: 1. Call get_episode_brief (and query_handbook) to inspect orders, routes, budget, permits, and equations.
2. Design each order (unit_count, unit_volume_m3, design_pressure_mpa, wall_thickness_mm, insulation, fittings).
3. Reserve bay slots via reserve_bay_and_order and assign delivery corridors via assign_transport.
4. When the mid-episode disruption triggers, inspect disruption_alert and get_factory_state, revise impacted bookings via revise_order, and book remaining orders under post-shock constraints.
5. Call finalize_commissioning before step 42; unfinalized episodes score 0.0.

materials_and_insulation.title: Cryogenic Media, Vacuum Insulation Systems, Fittings & Hazard Rules
hazard_compatibility_rules: LH2 and LHe strictly require EVI multi-layer screen-vacuum insulation (requires_evi=True); PVI fails HAZARD_INSULATION.
LH2 and LHe strictly forbid CN fittings (forbidden_fittings=['CN']); only EU_STD or DE_PRECISION are allowed.
LOX with design_pressure_mpa > 2.0 MPa strictly forbids CN fittings (LOX_IGNITION_RISK); oxygen-clean EU_STD or DE_PRECISION fittings are mandatory.

rules.designated_route_requirement: Each booked order MUST be assigned via assign_transport (or revise_order) to its customer-designated route: assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
rules.bridge_mass_cap: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg. Bridge/axle mass caps apply PER UNIT and CANNOT be waived by an escort permit. Splitting an order into unit_count = 2 or 3 smaller shells reduces per-unit transport mass.
rules.standard_clearance_no_permit: When use_escort_permit == False: shipping_width_mm <= route.std_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.std_max_height_mm.
rules.oversize_clearance_with_permit: When use_escort_permit == True: route.escort_permit_allowed == True AND shipping_width_mm <= route.permit_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.permit_max_height_mm.
rules.batch_permit_quota: Total orders claiming use_escort_permit == True across the batch must be <= effective_escort_permits_total. If exceeded, permit_quota_exceeded becomes True and ALL orders claiming use_escort_permit == True fail PERMIT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.

manufacturing_and_bays.title: Bay Scheduling, Crane Limits, Manufacturing Cost & Delivery Timeline

compute_fab_and_cost.base_fab: 2 + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 10.0 else 0) + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 20.0 else 0) + (1 if wall_thickness_mm >= 14.0 else 0) + (1 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 0)
compute_fab_and_cost.unit_cost_eur: (9500.0 + unit_volume_m3 * 2150.0 + unit_tare_mass_kg * 3.10) * insulation_cost_multiplier * fittings_cost_multiplier * (1.18 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 1.00) + fixed_kit_eur

bay_constraints.non_overlap: Two orders booked on the same bay cannot overlap half-open intervals [start_a, end_a) and [start_b, end_b): must have end_a <= start_b or end_b <= start_a.
bay_constraints.blackout_windows: A booking [bay_start_week, fab_end_week) cannot overlap any active BayBlackoutWindow [start_week, end_week) on the same bay.
bay_constraints.crane_tare_cap: If bay_max_unit_tare_kg is active on bay_id, unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg[bay_id].

delivery_week_formula.delivery_week: max(bay_start_week + fab_weeks, order_release_week + effective_fittings_lead_weeks) + ASSEMBLY_COMMISSION_WEEKS + route.transit_weeks

overview.title: CryoForge Commissioning Environment Overview & Catalogue Bounds
overview.mission: Configure, schedule, ship, and commission all 4 cryogenic vessel customer orders (ORD-1..ORD-4) across parallel fabrication bays (BAY-A, BAY-B) within the factory budget, escort-permit quota, route mass/gauge envelopes, and customer SLA deadlines, while adapting to a mid-episode supply/infrastructure shock.
overview.anti_oracle_invariant: reserve_bay_and_order and revise_order validate only discrete catalogue bounds, bay existence, bay schedule/blackout non-overlap, and active crane tare limits. They NEVER reveal hoop_stress_mpa, boil_off_pct_day, stress_pass, or boil_off_pass. Use run_physics_sim (limited to sim_budget_default calls) and/or compute exact equations from the physics section before finalizing.
workflow_checklist: 1. Call get_episode_brief (and query_handbook) to inspect orders, routes, budget, permits, and equations.
2. Design each order (unit_count, unit_volume_m3, design_pressure_mpa, wall_thickness_mm, insulation, fittings).
3. Reserve bay slots via reserve_bay_and_order and assign delivery corridors via assign_transport.
4. When the mid-episode disruption triggers, inspect disruption_alert and get_factory_state, revise impacted bookings via revise_order, and book remaining orders under post-shock constraints.
5. Call finalize_commissioning before step 42; unfinalized episodes score 0.0.

physics.title: Exact Cryogenic Vessel Geometry, Mass, Hoop Stress & Boil-Off Equations

materials_and_insulation.title: Cryogenic Media, Vacuum Insulation Systems, Fittings & Hazard Rules
hazard_compatibility_rules: LH2 and LHe strictly require EVI multi-layer screen-vacuum insulation (requires_evi=True); PVI fails HAZARD_INSULATION.
LH2 and LHe strictly forbid CN fittings (forbidden_fittings=['CN']); only EU_STD or DE_PRECISION are allowed.
LOX with design_pressure_mpa > 2.0 MPa strictly forbids CN fittings (LOX_IGNITION_RISK); oxygen-clean EU_STD or DE_PRECISION fittings are mandatory.

transport_and_routes.title: Heavy Cryogenic Transport Corridors, Bridge Caps & Escort Permits

rules.designated_route_requirement: Each booked order MUST be assigned via assign_transport (or revise_order) to its customer-designated route: assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
rules.bridge_mass_cap: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg. Bridge/axle mass caps apply PER UNIT and CANNOT be waived by an escort permit. Splitting an order into unit_count = 2 or 3 smaller shells reduces per-unit transport mass.
rules.standard_clearance_no_permit: When use_escort_permit == False: shipping_width_mm <= route.std_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.std_max_height_mm.
rules.oversize_clearance_with_permit: When use_escort_permit == True: route.escort_permit_allowed == True AND shipping_width_mm <= route.permit_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.permit_max_height_mm.
rules.batch_permit_quota: Total orders claiming use_escort_permit == True across the batch must be <= effective_escort_permits_total. If exceeded, permit_quota_exceeded becomes True and ALL orders claiming use_escort_permit == True fail PERMIT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.

manufacturing_and_bays.title: Bay Scheduling, Crane Limits, Manufacturing Cost & Delivery Timeline

compute_fab_and_cost.base_fab: 2 + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 10.0 else 0) + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 20.0 else 0) + (1 if wall_thickness_mm >= 14.0 else 0) + (1 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 0)
compute_fab_and_cost.unit_cost_eur: (9500.0 + unit_volume_m3 * 2150.0 + unit_tare_mass_kg * 3.10) * insulation_cost_multiplier * fittings_cost_multiplier * (1.18 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 1.00) + fixed_kit_eur

bay_constraints.non_overlap: Two orders booked on the same bay cannot overlap half-open intervals [start_a, end_a) and [start_b, end_b): must have end_a <= start_b or end_b <= start_a.
bay_constraints.blackout_windows: A booking [bay_start_week, fab_end_week) cannot overlap any active BayBlackoutWindow [start_week, end_week) on the same bay.
bay_constraints.crane_tare_cap: If bay_max_unit_tare_kg is active on bay_id, unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg[bay_id].

delivery_week_formula.delivery_week: max(bay_start_week + fab_weeks, order_release_week + effective_fittings_lead_weeks) + ASSEMBLY_COMMISSION_WEEKS + route.transit_weeks

disruptions_and_revisions.title: Mid-Episode Supply/Infrastructure Shocks, Release Weeks & Revision Fees

rules.trigger_condition: Successful factory mutations (reserve_bay_and_order, assign_transport, revise_order) increment mutation_count. The scenario's DisruptionEvent fires automatically once len(booked_orders) >= 2 OR mutation_count >= 4, whichever comes first.
rules.world_state_updates: When triggered, the DisruptionEvent immediately updates active fittings_lead_deltas, pvi_k_multiplier, effective_budget_eur (+ budget_delta_eur), effective_escort_permits_total (+ escort_permits_delta), bay_blackouts, bay_max_unit_tare_kg, route mass/height/permit overrides, and customer order min_pressure_mpa / sla_week overrides.
rules.order_release_week_rule: Orders booked before the shock start with order_release_week = 1. Once disruption_triggered is True, any NEW reserve_bay_and_order gets order_release_week = 2, and any revise_order that changes fittings or unit_count updates order_release_week = 2 (revisions that keep both fittings and unit_count unchanged retain their prior order_release_week).
rules.revision_retooling_fees: First post-shock revision of a booked order (disruption_triggered == True and post_shock_revised == False) costs 1500.0 EUR and marks post_shock_revised = True. Pre-shock revisions or repeat revisions of the same order cost 4500.0 EUR. All revision fees accumulate in retooling_fees_eur and count toward total_spent_eur.

scoring.title: Zero-Trust Verification & Batch Commissioning Scoring Formula
scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.
order_hard_checks: 1. Order is booked AND assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
2. Post-shock evaluate_design_physics has all_engineering_pass == True (capacity, pressure, hoop stress, material hazard compatibility, boil-off, site height & bank footprint).
3. Zero bay overlap with other booked orders on the same bay, zero overlap with active bay_blackouts, and unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg (if active).

4. Transport envelope satisfied: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg, shipping width/height within std or permit gauge, route.escort_permit_allowed if permit used, and total batch permits <= effective_escort_permits_total.
5. Schedule satisfied: delivery_week <= order.sla_week AND delivery_week <= horizon_weeks.

base_progress_credit.formula: raw_score = sum(0.85 * order.priority_weight for each order passing all 5 hard checks)

efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.eligibility: Awarded ONLY when valid_order_count == 4 and total_spent_eur <= effective_budget_eur
efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.schedule_margin_bonus: 0.04 * min(1.0, max(0.0, avg_slack_weeks / 2.0)), where avg_slack_weeks = mean(min(order.sla_week, horizon_weeks) - delivery_week)

budget_breach_penalty.total_spent_eur: sum(manufacturing_cost_eur + unit_count * base_freight_eur_per_unit + (permit_fee_eur if use_escort_permit else 0.0)) + retooling_fees_eur
budget_breach_penalty.penalty_if_exceeded: If total_spent_eur > effective_budget_eur: bonuses = 0.0 and score = min(score * 0.20, 0.15).

overview.title: CryoForge Commissioning Environment Overview & Catalogue Bounds
overview.mission: Configure, schedule, ship, and commission all 4 cryogenic vessel customer orders (ORD-1..ORD-4) across parallel fabrication bays (BAY-A, BAY-B) within the factory budget, escort-permit quota, route mass/gauge envelopes, and customer SLA deadlines, while adapting to a mid-episode supply/infrastructure shock.
overview.anti_oracle_invariant: reserve_bay_and_order and revise_order validate only discrete catalogue bounds, bay existence, bay schedule/blackout non-overlap, and active crane tare limits. They NEVER reveal hoop_stress_mpa, boil_off_pct_day, stress_pass, or boil_off_pass. Use run_physics_sim (limited to sim_budget_default calls) and/or compute exact equations from the physics section before finalizing.
workflow_checklist: 1. Call get_episode_brief (and query_handbook) to inspect orders, routes, budget, permits, and equations.
2. Design each order (unit_count, unit_volume_m3, design_pressure_mpa, wall_thickness_mm, insulation, fittings).
3. Reserve bay slots via reserve_bay_and_order and assign delivery corridors via assign_transport.
4. When the mid-episode disruption triggers, inspect disruption_alert and get_factory_state, revise impacted bookings via revise_order, and book remaining orders under post-shock constraints.
5. Call finalize_commissioning before step 42; unfinalized episodes score 0.0.

physics.title: Exact Cryogenic Vessel Geometry, Mass, Hoop Stress & Boil-Off Equations

materials_and_insulation.title: Cryogenic Media, Vacuum Insulation Systems, Fittings & Hazard Rules
hazard_compatibility_rules: LH2 and LHe strictly require EVI multi-layer screen-vacuum insulation (requires_evi=True); PVI fails HAZARD_INSULATION.
LH2 and LHe strictly forbid CN fittings (forbidden_fittings=['CN']); only EU_STD or DE_PRECISION are allowed.
LOX with design_pressure_mpa > 2.0 MPa strictly forbids CN fittings (LOX_IGNITION_RISK); oxygen-clean EU_STD or DE_PRECISION fittings are mandatory.

transport_and_routes.title: Heavy Cryogenic Transport Corridors, Bridge Caps & Escort Permits

rules.designated_route_requirement: Each booked order MUST be assigned via assign_transport (or revise_order) to its customer-designated route: assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
rules.bridge_mass_cap: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg. Bridge/axle mass caps apply PER UNIT and CANNOT be waived by an escort permit. Splitting an order into unit_count = 2 or 3 smaller shells reduces per-unit transport mass.
rules.standard_clearance_no_permit: When use_escort_permit == False: shipping_width_mm <= route.std_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.std_max_height_mm.
rules.oversize_clearance_with_permit: When use_escort_permit == True: route.escort_permit_allowed == True AND shipping_width_mm <= route.permit_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.permit_max_height_mm.
rules.batch_permit_quota: Total orders claiming use_escort_permit == True across the batch must be <= effective_escort_permits_total. If exceeded, permit_quota_exceeded becomes True and ALL orders claiming use_escort_permit == True fail PERMIT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.

manufacturing_and_bays.title: Bay Scheduling, Crane Limits, Manufacturing Cost & Delivery Timeline

compute_fab_and_cost.base_fab: 2 + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 10.0 else 0) + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 20.0 else 0) + (1 if wall_thickness_mm >= 14.0 else 0) + (1 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 0)
compute_fab_and_cost.unit_cost_eur: (9500.0 + unit_volume_m3 * 2150.0 + unit_tare_mass_kg * 3.10) * insulation_cost_multiplier * fittings_cost_multiplier * (1.18 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 1.00) + fixed_kit_eur

bay_constraints.non_overlap: Two orders booked on the same bay cannot overlap half-open intervals [start_a, end_a) and [start_b, end_b): must have end_a <= start_b or end_b <= start_a.
bay_constraints.blackout_windows: A booking [bay_start_week, fab_end_week) cannot overlap any active BayBlackoutWindow [start_week, end_week) on the same bay.
bay_constraints.crane_tare_cap: If bay_max_unit_tare_kg is active on bay_id, unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg[bay_id].

delivery_week_formula.delivery_week: max(bay_start_week + fab_weeks, order_release_week + effective_fittings_lead_weeks) + ASSEMBLY_COMMISSION_WEEKS + route.transit_weeks

disruptions_and_revisions.title: Mid-Episode Supply/Infrastructure Shocks, Release Weeks & Revision Fees

rules.trigger_condition: Successful factory mutations (reserve_bay_and_order, assign_transport, revise_order) increment mutation_count. The scenario's DisruptionEvent fires automatically once len(booked_orders) >= 2 OR mutation_count >= 4, whichever comes first.
rules.world_state_updates: When triggered, the DisruptionEvent immediately updates active fittings_lead_deltas, pvi_k_multiplier, effective_budget_eur (+ budget_delta_eur), effective_escort_permits_total (+ escort_permits_delta), bay_blackouts, bay_max_unit_tare_kg, route mass/height/permit overrides, and customer order min_pressure_mpa / sla_week overrides.
rules.order_release_week_rule: Orders booked before the shock start with order_release_week = 1. Once disruption_triggered is True, any NEW reserve_bay_and_order gets order_release_week = 2, and any revise_order that changes fittings or unit_count updates order_release_week = 2 (revisions that keep both fittings and unit_count unchanged retain their prior order_release_week).
rules.revision_retooling_fees: First post-shock revision of a booked order (disruption_triggered == True and post_shock_revised == False) costs 1500.0 EUR and marks post_shock_revised = True. Pre-shock revisions or repeat revisions of the same order cost 4500.0 EUR. All revision fees accumulate in retooling_fees_eur and count toward total_spent_eur.

scoring.title: Zero-Trust Verification & Batch Commissioning Scoring Formula
scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.
order_hard_checks: 1. Order is booked AND assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
2. Post-shock evaluate_design_physics has all_engineering_pass == True (capacity, pressure, hoop stress, material hazard compatibility, boil-off, site height & bank footprint).
3. Zero bay overlap with other booked orders on the same bay, zero overlap with active bay_blackouts, and unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg (if active).

4. Transport envelope satisfied: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg, shipping width/height within std or permit gauge, route.escort_permit_allowed if permit used, and total batch permits <= effective_escort_permits_total.
5. Schedule satisfied: delivery_week <= order.sla_week AND delivery_week <= horizon_weeks.

base_progress_credit.formula: raw_score = sum(0.85 * order.priority_weight for each order passing all 5 hard checks)

efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.eligibility: Awarded ONLY when valid_order_count == 4 and total_spent_eur <= effective_budget_eur
efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.schedule_margin_bonus: 0.04 * min(1.0, max(0.0, avg_slack_weeks / 2.0)), where avg_slack_weeks = mean(min(order.sla_week, horizon_weeks) - delivery_week)

budget_breach_penalty.total_spent_eur: sum(manufacturing_cost_eur + unit_count * base_freight_eur_per_unit + (permit_fee_eur if use_escort_permit else 0.0)) + retooling_fees_eur
budget_breach_penalty.penalty_if_exceeded: If total_spent_eur > effective_budget_eur: bonuses = 0.0 and score = min(score * 0.20, 0.15).

rules.standard_clearance_no_permit: When use_escort_permit == False: shipping_width_mm <= route.std_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.std_max_height_mm.
rules.oversize_clearance_with_permit: When use_escort_permit == True: route.escort_permit_allowed == True AND shipping_width_mm <= route.permit_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.permit_max_height_mm.

rules.trigger_condition: Successful factory mutations (reserve_bay_and_order, assign_transport, revise_order) increment mutation_count. The scenario's DisruptionEvent fires automatically once len(booked_orders) >= 2 OR mutation_count >= 4, whichever comes first.
rules.world_state_updates: When triggered, the DisruptionEvent immediately updates active fittings_lead_deltas, pvi_k_multiplier, effective_budget_eur (+ budget_delta_eur), effective_escort_permits_total (+ escort_permits_delta), bay_blackouts, bay_max_unit_tare_kg, route mass/height/permit overrides, and customer order min_pressure_mpa / sla_week overrides.
rules.order_release_week_rule: Orders booked before the shock start with order_release_week = 1. Once disruption_triggered is True, any NEW reserve_bay_and_order gets order_release_week = 2, and any revise_order that changes fittings or unit_count updates order_release_week = 2 (revisions that keep both fittings and unit_count unchanged retain their prior order_release_week).
rules.revision_retooling_fees: First post-shock revision of a booked order (disruption_triggered == True and post_shock_revised == False) costs 1500.0 EUR and marks post_shock_revised = True. scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.

budget_breach_penalty.total_spent_eur: sum(manufacturing_cost_eur + unit_count * base_freight_eur_per_unit + (permit_fee_eur if use_escort_permit else 0.0)) + retooling_fees_eur

rules.designated_route_requirement: Each booked order MUST be assigned via assign_transport (or revise_order) to its customer-designated route: assigned_route_id == order.route_id.

rules.standard_clearance_no_permit: When use_escort_permit == False: shipping_width_mm <= route.std_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.std_max_height_mm.
rules.oversize_clearance_with_permit: When use_escort_permit == True: route.escort_permit_allowed == True AND shipping_width_mm <= route.permit_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.permit_max_height_mm.

rules.trigger_condition: Successful factory mutations (reserve_bay_and_order, assign_transport, revise_order) increment mutation_count. The scenario's DisruptionEvent fires automatically once len(booked_orders) >= 2 OR mutation_count >= 4, whichever comes first.
rules.world_state_updates: When triggered, the DisruptionEvent immediately updates active fittings_lead_deltas, pvi_k_multiplier, effective_budget_eur (+ budget_delta_eur), effective_escort_permits_total (+ escort_permits_delta), bay_blackouts, bay_max_unit_tare_kg, route mass/height/permit overrides, and customer order min_pressure_mpa / sla_week overrides.
rules.order_release_week_rule: Orders booked before the shock start with order_release_week = 1. Once disruption_triggered is True, any NEW reserve_bay_and_order gets order_release_week = 2, and any revise_order that changes fittings or unit_count updates order_release_week = 2 (revisions that keep both fittings and unit_count unchanged retain their prior order_release_week).
rules.revision_retooling_fees: First post-shock revision of a booked order (disruption_triggered == True and post_shock_revised == False) costs 1500.0 EUR and marks post_shock_revised = True. scoring.title: Zero-Trust Verification & Batch Commissioning Scoring Formula
scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.
order_hard_checks: 1. Order is booked AND assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
2. Post-shock evaluate_design_physics has all_engineering_pass == True (capacity, pressure, hoop stress, material hazard compatibility, boil-off, site height & bank footprint).
3. Zero bay overlap with other booked orders on the same bay, zero overlap with active bay_blackouts, and unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg (if active).

4. Transport envelope satisfied: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg, shipping width/height within std or permit gauge, route.escort_permit_allowed if permit used, and total batch permits <= effective_escort_permits_total.
5. Schedule satisfied: delivery_week <= order.sla_week AND delivery_week <= horizon_weeks.

base_progress_credit.formula: raw_score = sum(0.85 * order.priority_weight for each order passing all 5 hard checks)

efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.eligibility: Awarded ONLY when valid_order_count == 4 and total_spent_eur <= effective_budget_eur
efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.schedule_margin_bonus: 0.04 * min(1.0, max(0.0, avg_slack_weeks / 2.0)), where avg_slack_weeks = mean(min(order.sla_week, horizon_weeks) - delivery_week)

budget_breach_penalty.total_spent_eur: sum(manufacturing_cost_eur + unit_count * base_freight_eur_per_unit + (permit_fee_eur if use_escort_permit else 0.0)) + retooling_fees_eur
budget_breach_penalty.penalty_if_exceeded: If total_spent_eur > effective_budget_eur: bonuses = 0.0 and score = min(score * 0.20, 0.15).

overview.mission: Configure, schedule, ship, and commission all 4 cryogenic vessel customer orders (ORD-1..ORD-4) across parallel fabrication bays (BAY-A, BAY-B) within the factory budget, escort-permit quota, route mass/gauge envelopes, and customer SLA deadlines, while adapting to a mid-episode supply/infrastructure shock.

Use run_physics_sim (limited to sim_budget_default calls) and/or compute exact equations from the physics section before finalizing.

2. Design each order (unit_count, unit_volume_m3, design_pressure_mpa, wall_thickness_mm, insulation, fittings).
3. Reserve bay slots via reserve_bay_and_order and assign delivery corridors via assign_transport.
4. When the mid-episode disruption triggers, inspect disruption_alert and get_factory_state, revise impacted bookings via revise_order, and book remaining orders under post-shock constraints.
5. Call finalize_commissioning before step 42; unfinalized episodes score 0.0.

rules.standard_clearance_no_permit: When use_escort_permit == False: shipping_width_mm <= route.std_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.std_max_height_mm.

disruptions_and_revisions.title: Mid-Episode Supply/Infrastructure Shocks, Release Weeks & Revision Fees

rules.trigger_condition: Successful factory mutations (reserve_bay_and_order, assign_transport, revise_order) increment mutation_count. The scenario's DisruptionEvent fires automatically once len(booked_orders) >= 2 OR mutation_count >= 4, whichever comes first.
rules.world_state_updates: When triggered, the DisruptionEvent immediately updates active fittings_lead_deltas, pvi_k_multiplier, effective_budget_eur (+ budget_delta_eur), effective_escort_permits_total (+ escort_permits_delta), bay_blackouts, bay_max_unit_tare_kg, route mass/height/permit overrides, and customer order min_pressure_mpa / sla_week overrides.
rules.order_release_week_rule: Orders booked before the shock start with order_release_week = 1. Once disruption_triggered is True, any NEW reserve_bay_and_order gets order_release_week = 2, and any revise_order that changes fittings or unit_count updates order_release_week = 2 (revisions that keep both fittings and unit_count unchanged retain their prior order_release_week).
rules.revision_retooling_fees: First post-shock revision of a booked order (disruption_triggered == True and post_shock_revised == False) costs 1500.0 EUR and marks post_shock_revised = True. Pre-shock revisions or repeat revisions of the same order cost 4500.0 EUR. All revision fees accumulate in retooling_fees_eur and count toward total_spent_eur.

scoring.title: Zero-Trust Verification & Batch Commissioning Scoring Formula
scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.
order_hard_checks: 1. Order is booked AND assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
2. Post-shock evaluate_design_physics has all_engineering_pass == True (capacity, pressure, hoop stress, material hazard compatibility, boil-off, site height & bank footprint).
3. Zero bay overlap with other booked orders on the same bay, zero overlap with active bay_blackouts, and unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg (if active).

4. Transport envelope satisfied: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg, shipping width/height within std or permit gauge, route.escort_permit_allowed if permit used, and total batch permits <= effective_escort_permits_total.
5. Schedule satisfied: delivery_week <= order.sla_week AND delivery_week <= horizon_weeks.

base_progress_credit.formula: raw_score = sum(0.85 * order.priority_weight for each order passing all 5 hard checks)

efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.eligibility: Awarded ONLY when valid_order_count == 4 and total_spent_eur <= effective_budget_eur
efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.schedule_margin_bonus: 0.04 * min(1.0, max(0.0, avg_slack_weeks / 2.0)), where avg_slack_weeks = mean(min(order.sla_week, horizon_weeks) - delivery_week)

budget_breach_penalty.total_spent_eur: sum(manufacturing_cost_eur + unit_count * base_freight_eur_per_unit + (permit_fee_eur if use_escort_permit else 0.0)) + retooling_fees_eur
budget_breach_penalty.penalty_if_exceeded: If total_spent_eur > effective_budget_eur: bonuses = 0.0 and score = min(score * 0.20, 0.15).

overview.title: CryoForge Commissioning Environment Overview & Catalogue Bounds
overview.mission: Configure, schedule, ship, and commission all 4 cryogenic vessel customer orders (ORD-1..ORD-4) across parallel fabrication bays (BAY-A, BAY-B) within the factory budget, escort-permit quota, route mass/gauge envelopes, and customer SLA deadlines, while adapting to a mid-episode supply/infrastructure shock.
overview.anti_oracle_invariant: reserve_bay_and_order and revise_order validate only discrete catalogue bounds, bay existence, bay schedule/blackout non-overlap, and active crane tare limits. They NEVER reveal hoop_stress_mpa, boil_off_pct_day, stress_pass, or boil_off_pass. Use run_physics_sim (limited to sim_budget_default calls) and/or compute exact equations from the physics section before finalizing.
workflow_checklist: 1. Call get_episode_brief (and query_handbook) to inspect orders, routes, budget, permits, and equations.
2. Design each order (unit_count, unit_volume_m3, design_pressure_mpa, wall_thickness_mm, insulation, fittings).
3. Reserve bay slots via reserve_bay_and_order and assign delivery corridors via assign_transport.
4. When the mid-episode disruption triggers, inspect disruption_alert and get_factory_state, revise impacted bookings via revise_order, and book remaining orders under post-shock constraints.
5. Call finalize_commissioning before step 42; unfinalized episodes score 0.0.

physics.title: Exact Cryogenic Vessel Geometry, Mass, Hoop Stress & Boil-Off Equations

materials_and_insulation.title: Cryogenic Media, Vacuum Insulation Systems, Fittings & Hazard Rules
hazard_compatibility_rules: LH2 and LHe strictly require EVI multi-layer screen-vacuum insulation (requires_evi=True); PVI fails HAZARD_INSULATION.
LH2 and LHe strictly forbid CN fittings (forbidden_fittings=['CN']); only EU_STD or DE_PRECISION are allowed.
LOX with design_pressure_mpa > 2.0 MPa strictly forbids CN fittings (LOX_IGNITION_RISK); oxygen-clean EU_STD or DE_PRECISION fittings are mandatory.

transport_and_routes.title: Heavy Cryogenic Transport Corridors, Bridge Caps & Escort Permits

rules.designated_route_requirement: Each booked order MUST be assigned via assign_transport (or revise_order) to its customer-designated route: assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
rules.bridge_mass_cap: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg. Bridge/axle mass caps apply PER UNIT and CANNOT be waived by an escort permit. Splitting an order into unit_count = 2 or 3 smaller shells reduces per-unit transport mass.
rules.standard_clearance_no_permit: When use_escort_permit == False: shipping_width_mm <= route.std_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.std_max_height_mm.
rules.oversize_clearance_with_permit: When use_escort_permit == True: route.escort_permit_allowed == True AND shipping_width_mm <= route.permit_max_width_mm AND shipping_height_mm <= route.permit_max_height_mm.
rules.batch_permit_quota: Total orders claiming use_escort_permit == True across the batch must be <= effective_escort_permits_total. If exceeded, permit_quota_exceeded becomes True and ALL orders claiming use_escort_permit == True fail PERMIT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.

manufacturing_and_bays.title: Bay Scheduling, Crane Limits, Manufacturing Cost & Delivery Timeline

compute_fab_and_cost.base_fab: 2 + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 10.0 else 0) + (1 if unit_volume_m3 >= 20.0 else 0) + (1 if wall_thickness_mm >= 14.0 else 0) + (1 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 0)
compute_fab_and_cost.unit_cost_eur: (9500.0 + unit_volume_m3 * 2150.0 + unit_tare_mass_kg * 3.10) * insulation_cost_multiplier * fittings_cost_multiplier * (1.18 if execution == 'TRANSPORTABLE' else 1.00) + fixed_kit_eur

bay_constraints.non_overlap: Two orders booked on the same bay cannot overlap half-open intervals [start_a, end_a) and [start_b, end_b): must have end_a <= start_b or end_b <= start_a.
bay_constraints.blackout_windows: A booking [bay_start_week, fab_end_week) cannot overlap any active BayBlackoutWindow [start_week, end_week) on the same bay.
bay_constraints.crane_tare_cap: If bay_max_unit_tare_kg is active on bay_id, unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg[bay_id].

delivery_week_formula.delivery_week: max(bay_start_week + fab_weeks, order_release_week + effective_fittings_lead_weeks) + ASSEMBLY_COMMISSION_WEEKS + route.transit_weeks

disruptions_and_revisions.title: Mid-Episode Supply/Infrastructure Shocks, Release Weeks & Revision Fees

rules.trigger_condition: Successful factory mutations (reserve_bay_and_order, assign_transport, revise_order) increment mutation_count. The scenario's DisruptionEvent fires automatically once len(booked_orders) >= 2 OR mutation_count >= 4, whichever comes first.
rules.world_state_updates: When triggered, the DisruptionEvent immediately updates active fittings_lead_deltas, pvi_k_multiplier, effective_budget_eur (+ budget_delta_eur), effective_escort_permits_total (+ escort_permits_delta), bay_blackouts, bay_max_unit_tare_kg, route mass/height/permit overrides, and customer order min_pressure_mpa / sla_week overrides.
rules.order_release_week_rule: Orders booked before the shock start with order_release_week = 1. Once disruption_triggered is True, any NEW reserve_bay_and_order gets order_release_week = 2, and any revise_order that changes fittings or unit_count updates order_release_week = 2 (revisions that keep both fittings and unit_count unchanged retain their prior order_release_week).
rules.revision_retooling_fees: First post-shock revision of a booked order (disruption_triggered == True and post_shock_revised == False) costs 1500.0 EUR and marks post_shock_revised = True. Pre-shock revisions or repeat revisions of the same order cost 4500.0 EUR. All revision fees accumulate in retooling_fees_eur and count toward total_spent_eur.

scoring.title: Zero-Trust Verification & Batch Commissioning Scoring Formula
scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.
order_hard_checks: 1. Order is booked AND assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
2. Post-shock evaluate_design_physics has all_engineering_pass == True (capacity, pressure, hoop stress, material hazard compatibility, boil-off, site height & bank footprint).
3. Zero bay overlap with other booked orders on the same bay, zero overlap with active bay_blackouts, and unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg (if active).

4. Transport envelope satisfied: unit_transport_mass_kg <= route.max_unit_transport_mass_kg, shipping width/height within std or permit gauge, route.escort_permit_allowed if permit used, and total batch permits <= effective_escort_permits_total.
5. Schedule satisfied: delivery_week <= order.sla_week AND delivery_week <= horizon_weeks.

base_progress_credit.formula: raw_score = sum(0.85 * order.priority_weight for each order passing all 5 hard checks)

efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.eligibility: Awarded ONLY when valid_order_count == 4 and total_spent_eur <= effective_budget_eur
efficiency_and_margin_bonuses.schedule_margin_bonus: 0.04 * min(1.0, max(0.0, avg_slack_weeks / 2.0)), where avg_slack_weeks = mean(min(order.sla_week, horizon_weeks) - delivery_week)

budget_breach_penalty.total_spent_eur: sum(manufacturing_cost_eur + unit_count * base_freight_eur_per_unit + (permit_fee_eur if use_escort_permit else 0.0)) + retooling_fees_eur
budget_breach_penalty.penalty_if_exceeded: If total_spent_eur > effective_budget_eur: bonuses = 0.0 and score = min(score * 0.20, 0.15).

rules.trigger_condition: Successful factory mutations (reserve_bay_and_order, assign_transport, revise_order) increment mutation_count. The scenario's DisruptionEvent fires automatically once len(booked_orders) >= 2 OR mutation_count >= 4, whichever comes first.

rules.order_release_week_rule: Orders booked before the shock start with order_release_week = 1. rules.revision_retooling_fees: First post-shock revision of a booked order (disruption_triggered == True and post_shock_revised == False) costs 1500.0 EUR and marks post_shock_revised = True. scoring.title: Zero-Trust Verification & Batch Commissioning Scoring Formula
scoring.finalization_gate: If finalize_commissioning() was NOT called before the episode ends, final_score = 0.0.
order_hard_checks: 1. Order is booked AND assigned_route_id == order.route_id.
2. Post-shock evaluate_design_physics has all_engineering_pass == True (capacity, pressure, hoop stress, material hazard compatibility, boil-off, site height & bank footprint).
3. Zero bay overlap with other booked orders on the same bay, zero overlap with active bay_blackouts, and unit_tare_mass_kg <= bay_max_unit_tare_kg (if active).

base_progress_credit.formula: raw_score = sum(0.85 * order.priority_weight for each order passing all 5 hard checks)
